summary: Railing material qty formulas: RFT → LengthRft (aliases Length, ActualLength, WidthRft, ActualLengthRft). RM → LengthRm. SQFT → AreaSqft. PC → 1. LengthRft is the commercial run length in feet from cart width (L/U = sum of spans). Prefer LengthRft over runningFeet for continuous bottom/hand rail (runningFeet is window perimeter).

evidence.tip: Admin Materials + Formulas: pick unit RFT → qty auto-fills LengthRft. Cost = LengthRft × rate.

suggestion: When an admin asks how to price continuous bottom rail / handrail per RFT, tell them: set Unit=RFT and Qty formula=LengthRft (Length or ActualLength also work). Do not use runningFeet for railings.
